description: Biological organisms and ecosystems with particular reference to mechanisms of change and human impacts on the environment. Focuses on: biodiversity (definition, assessment methods, loss, and evaluation); population biology (concepts and research methods); habitat loss; species extinction; exotic species and their impacts; and possibilities for human intervention in alleviating trends in species loss and ecosystem degradation.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of the following
    • admission to Certificate or Diploma program in Restoration of Natural Systems 
    • or permission of the program.
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of ES 348, ES 318, ES 320, ER 313, BIOL 370.
title: Biodiversity and Conservation Biology
